name: Santa Maria d'Oló (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the red rose of the arms, seeded yellow, barbed, stalked and leaved green.
history: The flag was approved on 6 May 1992 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1595 of 18 May 1992; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with the rose of the arms 7/9 of the height at the centre, red, seeded yellow, barbed, stalked and leaved green.
